name: clamp
title: Clamp
description: Content cut to a number of lines (6 by default), fading out, with a row under it: a button that shows it all, how many lines and words it has (each Chinese or Japanese character a word) and the app's actions (copy, open in a reader); in the color of the text around it, so it suits any bubble. Open and scrolled past its start, a bar sticks to the top saying whose it is and how far the reader is, and closes it, its start brought back into view. Focus moving into the cut-off part shows it. A bubbling revealmatch event with detail.range opens it when the match reaches below the cut.
